description: The section headed 'Use Sequences' in roles.md carries the permission-table header 'Role: Manage Sequences (query_use_sequences)'. The label has been copy-pasted from the preceding 'Manage Sequences' role, whose own table correctly reads 'Role: Manage Sequences (query_manage_sequences)'. So the page shows two tables both labelled 'Manage Sequences' with different internal names, and the Use Sequences role has no table bearing its own name. A reader scanning table headers - or any tool parsing them, which is how this POC reads the catalogue - gets the wrong label for query_use_sequences; this registry itself promoted the role under the wrong label in round 12 and corrected it in round 13. Fix: change the table header to 'Role: Use Sequences (query_use_sequences)'.
